bblocks.name: LDV RML Mapper
bblocks.abstract: OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON transformed to PROV-O RDF using an RML transform plugin.
bblocks.description: The transform uses the RML transformer plugin to convert OTLP resourceSpans into PROV-O RDF. Span and trace records become PROV activities and array-valued data object identifiers become qualified usage references. This is the transform done in scope of the Logboek Dataverwerkingen voor Objectgegevens research project

bblocks.name: Demo OGC API processes instance - LOF
bblocks.abstract: An example of an OGC API Processes implementation using building blocks - Local Outlier Factor
bblocks.description: This OGC API Process served as an example implementation in the LDV (Logboek Dataverwerkingen voor (geo) objecten) project. It uses a Local Outlier Factor Machine Learning Algorithm for classification of observations/measurements. The Process itself does not expose provenance information directly in the API, but in the implementation OpenTelemetry is used server side to create a trace with provenance information using the OpenTelemetry Trace/Span semantics and adhering to the Dutch LDV standard.

bblocks.name: Opentelemetry trace from Localoutlier Factor OGC API Process
bblocks.abstract: Opentelemetry trace from Localoutlier Factor OGC API Process (geonovum-labs.dtaas.ogcapi.processes.ldv.localoutlier)
bblocks.description: The generated Opentelemetry trace can be mapped to the corresponding Activity Type profile using the RML Mapper. This block holds the generated OpenTelemetry Trace. The geonovum-labs.dtaas.ogcapi.processes.ldv.opentelemetry-mapping-rml block demonstrates the transform to the corresponding Activity Type Profile
